Requirement Location:
RISC-V Unpriv. ISA, F extension: Single-Precision Floating-Point Computational Instructions
RISC-V Unpriv. ISA, D extension: Double-Precision Floating-Point Computational Instructions
RISC-V Unpriv. ISA, Zfh chapter (CVA6 XF16 config): Half-Precision Floating-Point Computational Instructions
IEEE 754-2008: 5.4.1 (addition/subtraction), 6.3 (sign of zero), 7.2 (invalid), 7.4 (overflow), 7.6 (inexact)
Feature Description:
rd = rs1 + rs2 / rs1 − rs2, rounded once per rm/frm.
- ∞ − ∞ (or ∞ + (−∞)) → canonical qNaN, NV.
- Any sNaN operand → canonical qNaN, NV; qNaN operand → canonical qNaN, no flag.
- Exact zero sum: +0 under RNE/RTZ/RUP, −0 under RDN; x − x follows the same rule.
- Overflow → ±INF or ±max-finite depending on rm, OF+NX.
- Subnormal inputs/results are handled without flush-to-zero.
Verification Goal:
1. Every operand-class pair, per op and fmt (2 × 10 × 10 × 3 = 600 bins).
2. Every reachable result class (9 bins).
3. fflags: no exception, NX, OF, NV.
4. Invalid cases: ∞ ± ∞ → NV, sNaN operand → NV.
5. Zero sign: +0 − (+0) under RNE (→ +0) and under RDN (→ −0).
6. Subnormal + subnormal giving a subnormal result, and giving a normal result (carry into the smallest normal), each × 4 rm.
Pass/Fail Criteria:
fpu_sb compares every response against the C/MPFR ref model:
- result_o bit-exact (incl. NaN-boxing of FP32/FP16 results)
- fpu_exception_o.cause (fflags) bit-exact
- each response matched to its request by trans_id; a response with no pending request is an error
Pass = 0 UVM_ERROR / UVM_FATAL in the test log.
Implementation:
fpu_comput_cov::cg_fadd_fsub
- cx_fadd_fsub_op1_class_x_op2_class_x_fmt: cp_op × cp_op1_class × cp_op2_class × cp_fmt
- cp_res_class, cp_flags {NO_EXCEPTION, NX, OF, NV}
- cp_inf_invalid, cp_nan_invalid
- cp_sub_zero_rne, cp_sub_zero_rdn
- cx_subnorm_subnorm_res_x_rnd, cx_subnorm_norm_res_x_rnd
Sampled on operand_b (rs1) and imm (rs2): fpu_wrap routes FADD/FSUB through those ports, operand_a is unused.
Tests:
fpu_random_test, fpu_single_op_test, fpu_op_group_test,
fpu_fmt_random_test, fpu_fmt_single_op_test, fpu_fmt_op_group_test,
fpu_random_op_bp_test, fpu_op_group_bp_test (back-to-back),
fpu_special_val_test (ZERO/INF/QNaN/SNaN operands)
Notes:
No UF bin: structurally unreachable. A tiny sum/difference of two FP numbers is always exact, and RISC-V raises UF only on tiny AND inexact.
No DZ bin: not defined for add/sub.
RMM excluded with ignore_bins in every rm coverpoint: the MPFR ref model cannot compute it (known limitation, see TESTS sheet).

- each response matched to its request by trans_id; a response with no pending request is an error

RISC-V Unpriv. ISA, D extension: Double-Precision Floating-Point Computational Instructions
RISC-V Unpriv. ISA, Zfh chapter (CVA6 XF16 config): Half-Precision Floating-Point Computational Instructions
IEEE 754-2008: 5.4.1 (fusedMultiplyAdd), 7.2 (invalid, incl. ∞×0 + qNaN), 7.4, 7.5, 7.6
Feature Description:
rd = ±(rs1 × rs2) ± rs3 with a single rounding.
- FMADD: (rs1×rs2)+rs3; FMSUB: (rs1×rs2)−rs3; FNMSUB: −(rs1×rs2)+rs3; FNMADD: −(rs1×rs2)−rs3.
- ∞ × 0 → NV even when rs3 is a qNaN (RISC-V choice; IEEE leaves it optional).
- ∞ × finite ± opposite ∞ → NV.
- sNaN in any operand → NV; result canonical qNaN.
- Tiny inexact → UF+NX; overflow → OF+NX.
Verification Goal:
1. 4 ops × every 3-operand class combination (4 × 10 × 10 × 10 = 4000 bins).
2. Op × fmt (12 bins).
3. Each operand's class × fmt (3 × 30 bins).
4. Every reachable result class (9 bins).
5. fflags: no exception, NX, UF, OF, NV.
6. NX under each of the 4 rounding modes.
Pass/Fail Criteria:
fpu_sb compares every response against the C/MPFR ref model:
- result_o bit-exact (incl. NaN-boxing of FP32/FP16 results)
- fpu_exception_o.cause (fflags) bit-exact
- each response matched to its request by trans_id; a response with no pending request is an error
Pass = 0 UVM_ERROR / UVM_FATAL in the test log.
Implementation:
fpu_comput_cov::cg_fma
- cx_fma_op1_x_op2_x_op3: cp_op × cp_op1_class × cp_op2_class × cp_op3_class
- cx_op_x_fmt
- cx_op1_class_x_fmt, cx_op2_class_x_fmt, cx_op3_class_x_fmt
- cp_res_class, cp_flags {NO_EXCEPTION, NX, UF, OF, NV}
- cx_inexact_x_rnd
rs1 = operand_a, rs2 = operand_b, rs3 = imm.
Tests:
fpu_random_test, fpu_single_op_test, fpu_op_group_test,
fpu_fmt_random_test, fpu_fmt_single_op_test, fpu_fmt_op_group_test,
fpu_random_op_bp_test, fpu_op_group_bp_test (back-to-back),
fpu_special_val_test (ZERO/INF/QNaN/SNaN operands)
Notes:
The 4-way class cross is not crossed with fmt (12 000 bins); fmt is covered per operand instead.
'rs1 = rs2 = rs3' register aliasing is a core concern, not visible at the FPU boundary (no register file).
DZ cannot be raised by FMA.
RMM excluded with ignore_bins in every rm coverpoint: the MPFR ref model cannot compute it (known limitation, see TESTS sheet).
